## Privacy check

This repository is public. Tick each box before asking for review (rules and placeholders: AGENTS.md, "Privacy and publishing").

- [ ] I ran `npm run privacy:check` (and `-- --file <notes.md>` for this description, if I wrote it to a file).
- [ ] No private repository names or their PR or issue numbers, no real machine, host or tailnet names (`*.ts.net`).
- [ ] No local paths or user names, private or tailnet IPs, webhook URLs, keys, tokens or other credentials, even partial.
- [ ] No real agent or bot wiring, production deployment specifics, personal workflow or approval notes, or family or employer details.
- [ ] Placeholders only, in the diff, the commit messages, this description and any screenshots.
